name: Local Operation Log
description: Every mutation is recorded in a local operation log before applying. The log is the source of truth for sync — all replication, conflict resolution, and replay derive from it.
purpose: Ensure every mutation is durably recorded in a local operation log before application, making the log the authoritative source for replication, conflict resolution, and replay.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutation goes through a log-write-before-apply pipeline.
The log is append-only with monotonic sequence numbers.
Log entries include causal metadata (origin, timestamp, dependencies).
Entries are readable in replay order for catch-up sync.
No mutation path bypasses the log.
